## NULL + n!=0 — DECISION (do not edit oracles)
ECS pins a **pointer precondition**, not a recovery behavior:
  valid: data != NULL || n == 0
  NULL with n > 0: **OUT OF DOMAIN** — undefined, not tested, not an acceptance vector.

Rationale:
- SPEC §5 already constrains n <= 4096 and a meaningful buffer; misuse is outside the admissible region.
- Two competent oracles diverging outside the surface is signal, not a bug. Silently reconciling them would destroy the property hash-and-seal was built to protect.
- Acceptance vectors and generation prompts never request NULL+n>0.

Oracles stay as sealed/revealed. No byte changes to crc32_agentA.c or crc32_agentB.c.
